about_the_game:
Life of a Cat is a cozy, relaxing game about decorating a house, taking care of your cute kittens and creating a friendly space for them to rest and play. This game is a perfect pick for some well-deserved relaxation and stress relief.

  • Decorate and Expand: Make sure your cats have planty of space to play and relax. Choose from hundreds of furniture and decorations and watch your cats interacting with everything you create.

  • Cute cats interacting with what you create: While you are very busy decorating and expanding the room don't forget that the most important part of the game are cats! Make sure they have food, toys and a proper place to relieve themselves!

  • Challenges: Challenges are additional gameplay element to make sure you are never bored while playing the game. Make your cat walk through the room without touching the floor or make it somehow touch the ceiling.

  • A stress-free zone: A cozy vibe, with a calming soundtrack and adorable cats that make it the perfect way to relax and unwind. It’s a little escape from everyday stress, letting you enjoy peaceful moments and recharge.
